title: Cofinal uniformizer reduction bounds in the recorded scalar models
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite, $T$ a scheme in the same universe, and $D$ its abelian coefficient-tower scalar presentation [det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian]. Let $M\in D(R)$ and $a\leq b$. Suppose every derived extension of $M$ along the canonical completed ell-power projection [def-sp-tower-reconstruction-data] has constructible cohomology in every degree [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf] and Tor amplitude in $[a,b]$ [def-weil-proetale-tor-amplitude]. Then every recorded uniformizer reduction scalarReductionDerivedExtension of $M$ has constructible cohomology in every degree and vanishing cohomology outside $[a,b]$. No completeness or original-object boundedness is assumed.

source.place: Proof final integral-category sentence, expanded step 12; normalization of universal scalar presentations.

proof.text: Factor ell=v*pi^e, e>=1. Choose a normalized universal family of scalar presentations. Localization uniqueness identifies each right adjoint with exact derived restriction; left-adjoint uniqueness identifies its left adjoints with D.scalar and with the recorded uniformizer reductions.

Transport the assumed constructibility and common Tor interval to the universal presentations, then apply the cofinal reduction theorem with the canonical completed projections. Transport the resulting constructibility and cohomology vanishing to the recorded uniformizer reduction functors. Tor transport follows by composing each representative isomorphism with the inverse comparison.
